claims.text: DD-Aug is a data augmentation pipeline that integrates Cinema 4-D and Stable Diffusion to generate synthetic images.
Cinema 4-D is used within DD-Aug to model key semantic features including contours, textures, and lighting conditions.
Stable Diffusion performs style transfer within DD-Aug to increase image realism and reduce domain gap.
DD-Aug yields a 2.5% to 10% improvement in detection accuracy across multiple advanced object detectors compared to models without data augmentation.

evidence.description: Evaluations on the deformable defect bearing dataset (NBBD) demonstrate that DD-Aug yields a 2.5%–10% improvement in detection accuracy across multiple advanced object detectors compared to models without augmentation.

methodologies.name: DD-Aug
methodologies.description: A synthetic data augmentation pipeline combining 3D modeling via Cinema 4-D with style transfer via Stable Diffusion.

limitations.text: Collecting high-quality and diverse datasets for supervised learning in industrial defect detection remains challenging.
Traditional synthetic data generation methods struggle with controlling key semantic features, leading to domain gaps that impair downstream performance.
